facts.text: Hotel Bel Ami is a 5-star hotel in Saint-Germain-des-Prés.
facts.excerpt: the standards of a 5-star hotel in Saint-Germain-des-Prés

facts.text: The hotel is at 7 rue Saint-Benoît in Paris's 6th arrondissement.
facts.excerpt: At 7 rue Saint-Benoît, in a 19th-century building that once housed the printing press of Bel-Ami in 1885, Hotel Bel Ami embodies the vibrant spirit of Paris’s 6th arrondissement

facts.text: The hotel occupies a 19th-century building that once housed the printing press of Bel-Ami in 1885.

facts.text: The hotel is steps from Café de Flore, Les Deux Magots and Place Saint-Germain-des-Prés.

facts.text: The rooms, suites and apartments were designed by architect Pascal Allaman.
facts.excerpt: Designed by architect Pascal Allaman as elegant, contemporary living spaces

facts.text: The rooms use natural oak, lacquered glass surfaces in subtle tones and clean graphic lines.
facts.excerpt: Natural oak, lacquered glass surfaces in subtle tones and clean graphic lines reflect a contemporary interpretation of Parisian elegance

facts.text: The hotel offers rooms, suites and apartments.
